title: Cross Site scripting/injection in SampleAjaxPlugin in Apache JSPWIKI on all versions prior to 3.0.1 on all platforms…
description: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the SampleAjaxPlugin of Apache JSPWIKI on all versions prior to 3.0.1. This flaw allows attackers to bypass page encoding, potentially causing raw HTML or JavaScript to be rendered on affected pages. Upgrading to version 3.0.1 addresses this issue.
